# Remove-ZbxDiscoveryRulePrototype

## SYNOPSIS

Removes discovery rule prototypes.

## SYNTAX

```
Remove-ZbxDiscoveryRulePrototype [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixDiscoveryRulePrototype>[]> [-Force] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A discovery rule prototype is a discovery rule that a parent discovery rule creates for each entity it finds, for nested discovery (Zabbix 7.4 and later). The Remove-ZbxDiscoveryRulePrototype cmdlet deletes the discovery rule prototypes given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with discoveryruleprototype.delete, all in one call when the pipeline ends. It asks for confirmation first unless -Confirm:$false or -Force is given, and -WhatIf lists what would be deleted. It writes nothing, and needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Delete a discovery rule prototype

```powershell
Get-ZbxDiscoveryRulePrototype -Host 'web-01' -Name 'Databases on {#INSTANCE}' | Remove-ZbxDiscoveryRulePrototype -Confirm:$false
```

Deletes the discovery rule prototype Databases on {#INSTANCE} of web-01. -Confirm:$false skips the prompt the command shows by default.

### Example 2: Preview deleting a discovery rule prototype

```powershell
Get-ZbxDiscoveryRulePrototype -Host 'web-01' -Name 'Databases on {#INSTANCE}' | Remove-ZbxDiscoveryRulePrototype -WhatIf
```

-WhatIf shows what the command would delete, and deletes nothing.
